"""Simulation template only, not an implemented or economically validated lab strategy."""

import numpy as np
import pandas as pd

from quant_lab.config import StrictModel
from quant_lab.strategies.base import BaseStrategy


class Parameters(StrictModel):
    pass


class IntegrationCandlePulseV1(BaseStrategy[Parameters]):
    name = "integration_candle_pulse_v1"
    version = "1.0.0"
    parameter_model = Parameters
    lab_modes = ("LONG_ONLY",)
    lab_timeframes = ("1h",)
    created_at = "2026-11-04T00:00:00Z"

    @classmethod
    def required_warmup(cls, parameters, timeframe):
        return 20

    def prepare_features(self, candles):
        frame = candles.copy()
        warm = np.arange(len(frame)) >= 20
        contiguous = frame.index.to_series().diff().eq(pd.Timedelta(hours=1))
        previous = frame.close.shift(1).le(frame.open.shift(1))
        frame["entry"] = warm & contiguous & previous & frame.close.gt(frame.open)
        frame["exit"] = warm & frame.close.lt(frame.open)
        return frame

    def generate_long_entries(self, features):
        return [bool(v) for v in features["entry"]]

    def generate_long_exits(self, features):
        return [bool(v) for v in features["exit"]]

    def generate_short_entries(self, features):
        return [False] * len(features)

    def generate_short_exits(self, features):
        return [False] * len(features)
